title: MCL Observability Dashboard — content-addressed telemetry
gate_source: EXP-603 agency loop stable -> real-time observable telemetry
location: game/observability/ (decoupled); dashboard renders L1 telemetry via dentatus.api only

data_stream.decision: content-addressed telemetry, NOT naive polling or raw socket
data_stream.rationale: polling re-runs the engine each tick (O(N^3) Fiedler dominates); push is better but still recomputes
data_stream.pioneering: every frame keyed by H_state (EXP-601/602 bit-perfect); Fiedler decomposition computed once per UNIQUE reality and cached; repeats render from cache
data_stream.transport: replay bundle (offline, deterministic) + SSE push stub (live); SSE sends full telemetry on first H_state, a reference on repeats
data_stream.equilibrium: lc-transitions rare at EMA equilibrium (EXP-409) -> live stream cycles few addresses -> near-zero recompute/bandwidth

telemetry.scalars: B_ent, B_ent_spectral, lambda_2, worst_ratio, epsilon, n_leaves, n_edges, beta_Z_eff, H_state
telemetry.fault: Fiedler vector sign bisects the manifold; the basin boundary is the fault line

assertions_fork_A: [2] telemetry block present: per-leaf center/size/fiedler/g_ent + fiedler_lambda
[3] Fiedler bisection: vector splits +/- (the fault line; ~balanced sign split)
[4] content-addressed: identical world -> identical telemetry (cache key valid)
[5] bundle determinism: export_bundle bit-stable across runs (PYTHONHASHSEED=0)
[6] content-address dedup: unique_states <= frames_total with >=1 cache hit
[7] witness purity: telemetry/frames carry no verdict-shaped field
[8] firewall numeric: admissibility derivable from worst_ratio vs epsilon (no boolean verdict in telemetry)
[9] committed reality: bundle.committed_H_verified == agency loop committed H_verified
[10] dashboard self-contained: mcl_dashboard.html embeds the bundle; external refs only from cdnjs
assertions_fork_B: [3] sorted |fiedler| multiset fwd == mir (fault structure P_yz-invariant up to eigenvector sign)
[5] telemetry H_state fwd == mir (realized world P_yz-invariant under seed x-stalk flip)

exp605_gate.trigger: dashboard live -> WebXR; multi-velocity tracking (EXP-506) + streaming world-sections (EXP-507) for galactic scale
exp605_gate.target: per-section local Fiedler (O(N^3) avoided at scale); SSE live deployment
